title: Nitroverts Announce Sophomore Album 'True Nature Of Antimatter'
excerpt: Electro-metal duo Nitroverts has announced their sophomore album ‘The True Nature Of Antimatter’ and released the single “Under My Skin.”
content:
Article Views: 1

Electro-metal duo Nitroverts have announced their sophomore album, True Nature of Antimatter, is now available for pre-order from FiXT.

Nitroverts unleash True Nature of Antimatter, a hard-hitting follow-up to Endogenous. The album delivers a chaotic fusion of alternative metal, nu metal, industrial rock, punk, and hard rock, balancing raw aggression with polished production. From the thrashing guitars and heavy vocals of “Under My Skin” to the driving intensity of “Sirens” and “Counterparts,” the album is packed with crushing riffs, industrial-tinged textures, and relentless energy.

The band’s skillful musicianship comes through across the album, with riveting vocals from Yann Zhanchak and guitars, electronic programming, mixing, and production from Ars Nikonov, also known for his retro synth project Fury Weekend. Raw, abrasive, and intensely produced, True Nature Of Antimatter showcases Nitroverts’ modern take on heavy rock while pushing the boundaries between metallic aggression and industrial electronics. If you enjoy brutal vocal performances, blistering guitars, provocative lyrics, and action-packed tracks from start to finish, True Nature Of Antimatter is the headbanging experience you’ve been waiting for.

Releasing alongside today’s pre-order announcement, Nitroverts unleash “Under My Skin,” a hard-hitting new single that blends thrashing guitars, heavy vocals, and industrial-tinged production into a relentless fusion of alternative metal and nu metal. Dark, aggressive, and packed with raw energy, the track delivers a modern take on heavy rock with an abrasive edge that gets firmly under your skin.

What do you get when you cross the classic rock/electronic ’80s vibe of Ars Nikonov’s Fury Weekend project with the impassioned, versatile, and high-octane vocals of Yann Zhanchak? You get Nitroverts, a hybrid electronic rock / nu-metal fusion collaboration between two Belarusian artists at the top of their game.
